description: Make a new version of a postcard designed with design_postcard: the same card code and link, changed as asked (for example a different color, drawing or wording). The new version replaces the current one on the card page. Only for a card that is not paid for yet. Do not include any street address, phone number or email.

change_request.description: What to change, in plain words.

sign_off.description: Only when the person asks for a new sign-off, exactly as they want it, e.g. "Best, Sam".

name: revise_postcard
title: Change a postcard
